heroPoints.mobile: Submit and approve leave requests on your phone
heroPoints.payslip: See your monthly payslip as soon as it is published

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your company email to sign in.
auth.rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this device
auth.forgotPasswordPending: Password reset is under development. Please contact the HR department.
auth.demoHint: Click an email to fill it in. Shared password: Demo@2026.

errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Account temporarily locked after too many failed sign-ins. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Please contact the system administrator.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.message: Your account is not allowed to open this page. Contact your system administrator if you need access.

roles.intro: Each role combines functional permissions with a data scope. Changes take effect when users refresh their session (up to 15 minutes).

hints.code: Uppercase letters, digits or underscores, e.g. SHIFT_LEAD. Cannot be changed later.
hints.dataScope: Limits which data holders of this role can see and act on.
hints.systemScope: System roles keep a fixed data scope.
hints.adminLocked: The System administrator role always keeps role management so nobody is locked out of this screen.
hints.inUse: Assigned to {{count}} users; remove it from them before deleting.

validation.codePattern: 2–50 letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter
validation.permissionsRequired: Please select at least one permission.

roles.confirmDelete: Delete role "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

users.effectNote: New roles take effect when the user refreshes their session (up to 15 minutes).

validation.roleRequired: A user must have at least one role.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: Someone else just changed this data. Reload the page and try again.
errors.ROLE_NO_PERMISSION: A role needs at least one permission.
errors.ROLE_ADMIN_MUST_MANAGE_ROLES: The System administrator role must keep role management.
errors.ROLE_SYSTEM_SCOPE_LOCKED: The data scope of a system role cannot be changed.
errors.ROLE_IN_USE: This role is assigned to {{assignedUserCount}} users. Remove it from them before deleting.
errors.USER_NO_ROLE: A user must have at least one role.
errors.USER_SELF_LOCKOUT: You cannot remove the role that lets you manage accounts from yourself.
errors.AUDIT_RANGE_INVALID: The start date must be on or before the end date.
errors.AUDIT_ENTITY_UNKNOWN: This table is not in the audit log.

audit.intro: Every create, update, delete and sign-in is recorded: who, when, which table, values before and after. The log cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.empty: No log entries match the filters.
